If you have no money, you may not use this Talent.

Witch!.name: Witch!
Witch!.text: You have learned magic through trial and error. Gain one Spell of your choice from any Colour Lore or the Lore of Witchcraft, even if you lack the appropriate Arcane Magic Talent. Further, treat that Spell’s Channelling Skill as a Basic Skill. You can memorise an additional such Spell (and treat its Channelling Skill as Basic) for 150 XP; further Spells cost 50 XP more each time. Possession of this Talent may attract the attention of witch hunters, and complicate matters should you wish to join an established magical tradition. You can spend 100 XP to lose this Talent and all associated Spells.

Ancestral Grudge.name: Ancestral Grudge
Ancestral Grudge.text: Max: Willpower Bonus There are entries in the Great Book of Grudges — those borne against Orcs, Goblins, and Skaven in particular — that are so grievous they can only be avenged with the extinction of all their kind. You have inherited one of these fabled grudges, and whilst you have no chance of seeing it completed in your lifetime, you are more than happy to do your part. Choose a culture or faction that is the target of your Ancestral Grudge (e.g. Orcs, Goblins, Skaven, Trolls, Daemons of Khorne, etc.). Enter them into your Book of Grudges as the target of your vengeance, per the rules on page 31. You bear this group a Blood Grudge that can never be satisfied. However, every time you win a significant victory against this group — e.g. by destroying their works, taking back something stolen, or killing many of their kind — you gain 50 XP. Each time you purchase this Talent, you gain an Ancestral Grudge against a different faction. At the GM’s discretion, declaring vengeance against a smaller sub-faction can award more XP when you score victory over them — e.g. you gain 75 XP each victory if your target is a specific Goblin tribe, or 100 XP each victory if targeting a specific Human family line.

Bludgeoner.name: Bludgeoner
Bludgeoner.text: Max: Strength Bonus Tests: Strength Tests when activating Pummel Quality You smash more powerful enemies into submission with brutal hammer swings to the head, leaving them utterly exposed whilst you finish them off. When you win an opposed Test to activate the Pummel Quality, you inflict an additional Stunned Condition for each level of Bludgeoner.

Crew Commander.name: Crew Commander
Crew Commander.text: Max: Initiative bonus Tests: Ranged Tests when firing weapon with the Crewed Flaw You are practised at managing crews of siege weapons and artillery pieces. As an Action you may make a Challenging (+0) Leadership Test to help a crew manning a weapon with the Crewed Flaw within earshot. If you succeed, the crew members may use your Ranged Skill on the next attack using the weapon.

Demolisher.name: Demolisher
Demolisher.text: Max: Strength Bonus Tests: Melee when breaking inanimate objects using a Hack weapon Cover and armour is no defence against the bite of your axe. When you activate the Hack Quality as part of an attack, you inflict +1 additional Damage on struck armour or shields for each level of Demolisher. In addition, when attacking an enemy in cover with a weapon that has the Hack Quality, hard cover counts as medium cover, medium cover counts as soft cover, and soft cover provides no protection at all.

Dragon Belcher.name: Dragon Belcher
Dragon Belcher.text: Max: Ballistic Skill Bonus Certain Goblin tribes have been known to refer to Dwarf firearms as ‘dragon belchers’, for the furious roar and explosion of smoke they discharge as they fire. You make the most of this psychological impact to scatter and pin your opponents with suppressive fire. When you fire a weapon with the Blackpowder Quality, targeted enemies who fail their Cool Test gain an additional Broken Condition for each level of Dragon Belcher.

Entrenchment.name: Entrenchment
Entrenchment.text: Max: Intelligence Bonus Tests: Trade when constructing protective cover You make the most of whatever terrain is available to you to protect yourself and allies from enemy missile fire. When you are in soft cover, attacks against you are Hard (-20) instead of Difficult (-10). When you are in medium cover, attacks against you are Very Hard (-30) instead of Hard (-20).

Forgefire.name: Forgefire
Forgefire.text: Max: 1 You are a living battery of runic power, radiating an aura of battle-fury that imbues nearby weapons with the heat of their forging. When you are Engaged, any melee weapons wielded by yourself or an ally within Willpower Bonus yards gain the Penetrating Quality. If an affected weapon is already Penetrating, its attacks now ignore 1 additional point of metal armour.

Glorious Demise.name: Glorious Demise
Glorious Demise.text: Max: 1 Your bloodlust is so strong it overwhelms your body’s natural instinct to rest after trauma. When you gain the Unconscious Condition, you can interrupt the Turn order to make an immediate Melee attack as a Free Action, before you are taken out of action. When you gain the Stunned Condition, you can spend a Fortune point to make an immediate Melee attack as a Free Action. You take your next Turn as usual, which means you cannot take an Action if you’re still Stunned.

Harpooner.name: Harpooner
Harpooner.text: Max: Ballistic Skill Bonus As a veteran quareller, you use precision shooting to neutralise your target, impaling them with bolts in extremely painful locations. When you inflict a Critical Hit with a Crossbow weapon, you may increase your roll on the Critical Hit table by +10 for each level of Harpooner, to a maximum of 00. In addition, Crossbow bolts lodged into the target’s body due to the Impale Quality reduce the target’s Movement by 1 per bolt, to a minimum of 1.

Kingsguard.name: Kingsguard
Kingsguard.text: Max: 3 You are sworn to defend the life of your lord, and any they designate under your protection. If that means sacrificing your own life to shield your charge, you are prepared to do so. Any enemy attacks against an ally within 2 yards of you suffers a -10 modifier for each level of Kingsguard. This Talent does not apply to attacks against yourself, nor does it apply if you are currently suffering from a Condition.

Liquid Fortification.name: Liquid Fortification
Liquid Fortification.text: Max: Toughness Bonus Tests: Consume Alcohol Many Dwarfs insist that good ale can steady the nerves and improve the fighting proficiency of a hearty warrior. Nonetheless, a prudent fighter is careful not to become too reliant on alcohol, lest they become afflicted with “brew-fever”. You gain +10 Strength and Toughness after consuming an alcoholic drink. This provides an immediate bonus to your Consume Alcohol Test for consuming the drink, and the benefit continues to apply whether you succeed or fail on that Test. You retain this bonus until an hour has passed since your last alcoholic drink — drinking again can prolong the effect, but does not increase your Characteristic bonuses beyond +10.

Long Memory.name: Long Memory
Long Memory.text: Max: Intelligence Bonus Tests: Intelligence Tests to remember You never forget a face — or a promise. Unlike the Elven Tower of Memories technique (WFRP Core Rulebook), which Dwarfs consider frivolous and flawed, you use a form of sense memory to anchor details in the real places where you witnessed them, by recalling a specific feeling, taste, or smell from that location. When recalling significant events you were involved in previously in the campaign, you can perfectly remember the time, date, location, and visible faces of all individuals present, and exactly what those present pledged to say or do. If recalling a significant event you witnessed before the campaign began, you may need to take an Intelligence Test to remember details, with a difficulty set by the intervening time — Easy (+40) for events mere months ago, Hard (-20) for events a century ago.

Magic Defiance.name: Magic Defiance
Magic Defiance.text: Max: 1 Tests: Willpower Tests to use Magic Resistance (WFRP Core Rulebook) You ground enemy spellcraft through your own body, refusing to be affected by its fickle enchantments. You can Reverse any Test you are obliged to make as part of a magic spell’s effects. Additionally, once per adventure you may spend a Fortune Point to negate the effects of spell that has successfully be cast on you.

Master Rune Magic.name: Master Rune Magic
Master Rune Magic.text: Max: Willpower Bonus Tests: Runesmithing You have learned the secret rites of creating a master rune… but whether you have the skill to successfully forge one still awaits to be seen. Choose a master rune from pages 125-129. If your Talent specifies a runic form or forms (e.g. Protection Runes), you must choose a master rune from the specified lists. You can use the Forge Rune Endeavour to inscribe your chosen master rune on an item. Each time you purchase this Talent, you learn a new master rune you can craft. See page 119 for full runesmithing rules. In addition, the first time you acquire this Talent, you also learn all three Doom Runes (page 130).

Maverick.name: Maverick
Maverick.text: Max: Agility Bonus Tests: Sail (Skycraft) Tests to fly fast and dangerous You are an experienced, if reckless, flyer, putting your faith in high speed and overwhelming firepower. You do not suffer the -20 penalty on Ranged attacks when using the Flight Creature Trait.

Rune Magic.name: Rune Magic
Rune Magic.text: Max: Intelligence Bonus + Willpower Bonus Tests: Runesmithing You are inducted into the secret arcane traditions of the Dwarfs, with the knowledge of crafting magical runes. Choose a rune from pages 125 - 129. You cannot select a master rune. If your Talent specifies a runic form or forms (e.g. Protection Runes), you must choose a rune from the specified lists. Finally, if your Talent specifies a specific rune (e.g. the Rune of Stone), you must choose that specific rune. You can use the Forge Rune Endeavour to inscribe your chosen rune on an item. Each time you purchase this Talent, you learn a new rune you can craft.

Short Fuse.name: Short Fuse
Short Fuse.text: Max: Intelligence Bonus You time your explosives carefully to detonate at the optimum moment, showering fragments over the widest possible distance. When using an Explosive weapon with the Blast Quality, increase its Rating by +1 for each level of Short Fuse.

Tireless.name: Tireless
Tireless.text: Max: Toughness Bonus You endure heavy burdens, tiring journeys, and interrupted sleep with admirable resolve, refusing to let such ordeals dull your mind or slow your fighting strength. When you apply penalties due to suffering from the Fatigued Condition, you may ignore 1 instance of the Fatigued Condition, +1 additional Fatigued Condition for each level of Tireless. For example, a Character with 4 Fatigued Conditions and 2 levels of Tireless would ignore the effect of 3 Fatigued Conditions, suffering only a -10 penalty to all Tests.

Underminer.name: Underminer
Underminer.text: Max: Agility Bonus Tests: Melee You rarely have a height advantage over your enemies, but have learned to compensate by attacking from an unexpected angle. You do not suffer penalties for attacking whilst you have the Prone Condition, or are otherwise beneath your target. Enemies do not get a bonus to attack you whilst you have the Prone Condition. You gain an additional +20 to hit Surprised enemies, when you are emerging from a tunnel, pit, or other hidden position below them.

Whirlwind of Death.name: Whirlwind of Death
Whirlwind of Death.text: Max: 1 You attack in a sweeping, indiscriminate, fury, tearing through whole formations of enemy warriors. As an Action, you can spend 1 Fortune to make a Melee attack against all creatures Engaged with you. The GM chooses one enemy to Oppose this Test. If your attack succeeds, you inflict the same Damage to the same Hit Location against all Engaged creatures, calculated as normal. Do not apply Criticals on Whirlwind of Death attacks, though Critical Wounds are inflicted on enemies reduced to 0 Wounds as normal. You cannot activate any other special attack options as part of a Whirlwind of Death. However, if a Character with Dual Wielder (WFRP Core Rulebook) is wielding two weapons as part of a Whirlwind of Death, they may Reverse their Melee attack Test.

Martial Arts.name: Martial Arts
Martial Arts.text: Max: Weapon Skill Bonus Your unarmed attacks lose Undamaging. Each subsequent level, you can use one of the following Qualities unarmed: Damaging, Defensive, Distract, Fast, Penetrating, Precise, Pummel. When combat begins or one of your Turns starts, choose one Quality to use until your next Turn. WAY OF THE SWORD Swordmasters are trained in the ancient art of Sword- Dancing. These techniques can only be performed with a pure heart and mind, utilising a form of High Magic with a Greatsword of Hoeth, a blade that is as unique as the Swordmaster who wields it. Every day, at sunrise or sunset, a Swordmaster performs a cleansing ritual with their Greatsword, moving fluidly between thirty basic forms to maintain Yenlui. Though the Way of the Sword is taught primarily to those in the Order of Swordmasters, it is believed there are reclusive High Elf colonies where remnants of the ancient art are still taught. If so, it will be an older form of sword-dancing that does not require a Greatsword of Hoeth but may use an enchanted sword passed down as a family heirloom from the time of Aenarion.

Sword-dancing.name: Sword-dancing
Sword-dancing.text: Max: 1 You have studied the ancient tradition of Sword-dancing and can now memorise its mystical techniques. You learn the Ritual of Cleansing technique. You can learn additional techniques for 100 XP per technique you currently know. So, if you already know 3 techniques, your next technique costs 300 XP to purchase. Sword-dancing Tests With intricate and precise movements of body and blade, you channel magic to perform a Sword-dancing technique. To do this, make a Melee (Two-handed) Test. If your SL reaches the target number (the SL listed in the individual technique description), you succeed and perform the technique as explained in its description. If you fail, you lose all Advantage. On an Astounding Failure, you must also roll on the Oops! Table (WRFP, page 160).. Spiritual balance is required to make the best of Sword- dancing. The Difficulty of the Melee (Two-Handed) Test varies according to the Yenlui State of the Character making the Test. Yenlui (Balanced): Challenging (+0) 0 Yenlui (Light): Challenging (+0) 0 Yenlui (Dark): Very Hard (–30) 0

Blessed by Isha.name: Blessed by Isha
Blessed by Isha.text: Max: 1 Only Elves can take this Talent. You served as a novitiate of Isha and received the everqueen’s blessing in Ulthuan (if you are of the Asur), or Ariel’s blessing in Athel Loren (if you are of the Asrai). You may now learn the High Magic Talent.

High Magic.name: High Magic
High Magic.text: Channelling (Qhaysh) Skill and Blessed by Isha Talent can take this Talent. When you first take this Talent, you benefit from the ability to draw upon Winds of Magic that would otherwise be inaccessible. When casting a spell from the Lores of Beasts, Death, Fire, Heavens, Life, Light, Metal, or Shadows, lack of access to a particular Wind does not impact spellcasting. If you successfully cast a spell, your level in High Magic is added to the Overcasting SL you can spend on Overcasting High Magic spells. You may now memorise spells from the Lore of High Magic for the following cost in XP: Number of High Magic spells XP cost for a new currently known High Magic spell Up to Intelligence Bonus x 1 200 XP Up to Intelligence Bonus x 2 400 XP Up to Intelligence Bonus x 3 600 XP Up to Intelligence Bonus x 4 800 XP …and so on.

Lileath’s Blessing.name: Lileath’s Blessing
Lileath’s Blessing.text: Max: Initiative Bonus Tests: Channelling (Qhaysh) You have mastered the advanced art of using celestial movements, dreams, and divination to augment the magic of Qhaysh. For each level in Lileath’s Blessing, add +1 SL to Channelling (Qhaysh) Tests. Additionally, each level in Lileath’s Blessing lets you cast an additional aura spell even when you already have another Ward-granting spell in play. This multicasting benefit applies to High Magic spells as well as Colour spells. Fifth Level Careers Certain High Elf spellcasters can enter a fifth level in their Career. These careers are the Mage (page 90), the Smith-priest of Vaul (page 100), the Storm Weaver (page 104), and the Loremaster of Hoeth (page 108). In order to complete the fifth level of a Career, you must have 25 Advances in all your Career level’s seven Characteristics and in eight of its available Skills. You must also have at least 1 Talent from your current Career level. Skills and Talents you have gained from advancement prior to entering your current Career may count towards this. Other Gods Aside from the Cadai and Cytharai, there are six other major gods. Little loved by the Asur or the Druchii, the High Elves treat these deities with as much caution and distaste as they do the Cytharai.

Mind over Body.name: Mind over Body
Mind over Body.text: Max: 3 This meditative technique enables an Elf spellcaster to endure physical suffering and even allows them to see after they have been permanently blinded. To make use of this Talent, you must spend no less than twenty minutes in quiet contemplation before making a Challenging (+0) Pray Test. If you pass, you gain the following benefits for 1d10 + SLd10 hours. 1 level: You gain the Painless Creature Trait and do 0 not receive Conditions caused by pain. 2 levels: You gain divine sight. You can see the 0 shapes of objects or creatures in your mind’s eye, but not colours, facial expressions, or fine details, save in crafted objects. You make Trade (Smith) Tests without penalty for blindness, and you are immune to the Blinded Condition, even from magical or divine sources. 3 levels: You can use Resolve to ignore Critical 0 Wound penalties on Extended Tests (such as Crafting Endeavours).

Cadai Meditation.name: Cadai Meditation
Cadai Meditation.text: You have learned the basic divine meditation techniques for better achieving a State of Yenlui (Light). Each day during which you meditate for at least an hour and then make an Average (+20) Pray Test. If the Test is successful you can adjust your Yenlui State to Yenlui (Light). Worship of Mathlann Mathlann, the Lord of Sea and Storms, is worshipped as both a protector and a destroyer. The Elven sea god is usually depicted wearing armour of fish scales and a crown of seashells. At the dawn of time, Mathlann was born from Ellinill, the Lord of Destruction, and over the ages He has in turn birthed several minor sea gods himself. Mathlann is the only one of Ellinill’s five surviving god-children the High Elves consider part of the Cadai pantheon. Mathlann is the most popular of the eight Cadai gods among the Dark Elves. Whilst the Asur honour Mathlann’s protective tendencies, the Druchii favour his destructive ones. Among Wood Elves, Mathlann is more highly favoured by the coastal Eonir kindreds than the landlocked Asrai. In the High Elf kingdom of Cothique, where Storm Weavers commune with the mighty krakens, merwyrms, and megalodons, Mathlann is honoured as the king of sea creatures. The fish-bonding caraidh houses that inhabit the Shifting Isles revere Mathlann even above Asuryan. Cothiqui sea monster hunters vie for Mathlann’s favour but must not overhunt the creatures who call his realm their home lest they incur his wrath. The priesthood of Mathlann often clashes with overzealous hunter-cults of Anath Raema, who pursue the denizens of the deep with reckless abandon. TENETS OF MATHLANN Respect the creatures of the sea. Give prayer and 0 sacrifice to Mathlann for his generous bounty. Allow the sea to have its due, for those who anger 0 Mathlann must know his wrath. Never take Mathlann’s grace lightly. Always heed 0 his shrines with prayer and sacrifice. Pray towards the direction of the wind but speak 0 away from it. Bathe in salt water. Scrub the body clean with kelp 0 and beach sand.

Eye of the Storm.name: Eye of the Storm
Eye of the Storm.text: Max: 3 This meditative technique improves the focus and resilience of an Elf spellcaster, and those who fully master it can influence the weather. To make use of this Talent, you must spend no less than twenty minutes in quiet contemplation before making a Challenging (+0) Pray Test. If you pass, you gain the following benefits for 1d10 + SLd10 hours. 1 level: You are immune to any distractions that 0 would normally interrupt Channelling. 2 levels: You recover Fatigued Conditions in half 0 the normal time that has been decided by the GM (WFRP, page 169). In addition, you can ignore penalties to Channelling and Casting Tests from Fatigued Conditions. 3 levels: When rolling on a Weather table (see 0 Sea of Claws, page 106 or Deft Steps Light Fingers, page 114), you may add or subtract 1 from all die rolls.

Sanctuary of the Mind.name: Sanctuary of the Mind
Sanctuary of the Mind.text: Max: 3 Hoeth’s meditative techniques are used by Elf spellcasters to shield their minds from corruption and insanity. To make use of this Talent, you must spend no less than twenty minutes in quiet contemplation before making a Challenging (+0) Pray Test. if you pass, you gain the following benefits for 1d10 + SLd10 hours. 1 level: You are immune to any Corruption points 0 that result from spellcasting. 2 levels: You can add +1 SL to any Research Tests 0 you make. 3 levels: You are exempt from the negative modifiers 0 that result from Yenlui States (see page 47). Playing a Priest of Hoeth Loremasters have no priestly duties or strict hierarchy, enabling them to quest abroad for knowledge that cannot be found in their libraries. Even High Loremaster Teclis is seldom found at the White Tower, however the Sapherian order includes many accomplished Loremasters that govern by council in his absence. A Loremaster’s journeys may bring them to Hoeth’s library in the Laurelorn forest, or the High Elven colonies in Lustria or the Southlands. Social status and contacts afford Loremasters access to vast information resources and logistical support. Certain challenges simply require casting a spell to communicate with the White Tower. However, Loremasters also bear heavy burdens of responsibility. For every problem that is solved with magic, two more complications usually land on their plates. Players choosing the Loremaster of Hoeth Career should be prepared for embroilment in Asur political intrigues that introduce new enemies regardless of which side they support.

Your forge erupts into a massive explosion that leaves

hand. It will not burn you, but will emit heat and set flammable
objects alight, like a natural flame.
spells.summary: 손바닥에 작은 불꽃을 만듭니다. 시전자에게 화상을 입히지 않으며, 열을 내고 가연물에 불을 붙입니다.
spells.textKo: 손바닥에 작은 불꽃을 만듭니다. 시전자에게 화상을 입히지 않으며, 열을 내고 가연물에 불을 붙입니다.

spells.name: Marsh Lights
spells.text:
You create a number of flickering magical lights up to your
Intelligence Bonus. They resemble torches or hooded lanterns.
Provided they remain within line of sight, for your Action
you may control the lights by passing an Average (+2 SL)
Willpower Test; a success allows you to send the lights moving
in any direction. They will move at walking pace in a straight
line, passing through any objects (or witnesses) in their path,
unless you Test again to change their direction.
spells.summary: 지능 보너스만큼 불빛을 만듭니다. 시야 안에서 행동과 보통(+2 SL) 의지 판정으로 걷는 속도로 움직이거나 방향을 바꿉니다.
spells.textKo: 지능 보너스만큼 불빛을 만듭니다. 시야 안에서 행동과 보통(+2 SL) 의지 판정으로 걷는 속도로 움직이거나 방향을 바꿉니다.

spells.name: Murmured Whisper
spells.text:
You cast your voice at a point within Willpower yards,regardless
of line of sight.Your voice sounds from this point, and all within
earshot will hear it.
spells.summary: 시야와 무관하게 사거리 안의 한 지점에서 자신의 목소리가 들리게 합니다.
spells.textKo: 시야와 무관하게 사거리 안의 한 지점에서 자신의 목소리가 들리게 합니다.

spells.name: Open Lock
spells.text: One non-magical lock you touch opens.
spells.summary: 접촉한 비마법 자물쇠 하나를 엽니다.
spells.textKo: 접촉한 비마법 자물쇠 하나를 엽니다.

spells.name: Produce Small Animal
spells.text:
You reach into a bag, pocket, or hat, or under a rock, bush or
burrow, producing a small animal of a type you would expect
to find in the vicinity, such as a rabbit, dove, or rat. If there
are no appropriate local animals, the Spell does nothing. The
temperament of the animal is not guaranteed.
spells.summary: 주변에서 발견될 만한 작은 동물을 주머니·모자·바위 아래 등에서 꺼냅니다. 적합한 동물이 없으면 효과가 없으며 성향도 통제하지 못합니다.
spells.textKo: 주변에서 발견될 만한 작은 동물을 주머니·모자·바위 아래 등에서 꺼냅니다. 적합한 동물이 없으면 효과가 없으며 성향도 통제하지 못합니다.

spells.name: Protection from Rain
spells.text:
You can keep yourself and your possessions dry whatever the
weather, unaffected by precipitation.This affects rain, hail, sleet,
and snow, and any similar water falling from the heavens, but
not standing water.
spells.summary: 비·눈·우박 등 하늘에서 떨어지는 물로부터 자신과 소지품을 건조하게 유지합니다. 고인 물에는 적용되지 않습니다.
spells.textKo: 비·눈·우박 등 하늘에서 떨어지는 물로부터 자신과 소지품을 건조하게 유지합니다. 고인 물에는 적용되지 않습니다.

spells.name: Purify Water
spells.text:
You purify all water within a receptacle, such as a water flask,
stein, or jug. All non-magical impurities, such as poison or
contaminants are removed, leaving crisp, clear, potable water.
If the vessel contains another liquid that is predominantly
water — such as ale or wine — this is also purified, turning into
delicious, pure, non-alcoholic water.
WARHAMMER FANTASY ROLEPL AY
spells.summary: 한 용기 속 물에서 비마법 독과 오염물을 제거합니다. 물이 주성분인 술도 순수한 음용수로 바뀝니다.
spells.textKo: 한 용기 속 물에서 비마법 독과 오염물을 제거합니다. 물이 주성분인 술도 순수한 음용수로 바뀝니다.

spells.name: Rot
spells.text:
You cause a roughly fist-sized volume of organic material to
immediately rot. Foodstuffs perish, clothes crumble, leathers
shrivel (losing 1 Armour Point on 1 Hit Location), and similar,
as dictated by the GM.
spells.summary: 주먹 크기 정도의 유기물을 썩힙니다. 가죽 방어구에 사용하면 한 부위의 방어점이 1 감소합니다. 기타 물품의 손상은 GM이 판정합니다.
spells.textKo: 주먹 크기 정도의 유기물을 썩힙니다. 가죽 방어구에 사용하면 한 부위의 방어점이 1 감소합니다. 기타 물품의 손상은 GM이 판정합니다.

spells.name: Shock
spells.text: Your target receives 1 Stunned Condition.
spells.summary: 접촉한 대상에게 기절 1개를 부여합니다.
spells.textKo: 접촉한 대상에게 기절 1개를 부여합니다.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.text:
You touch the target, sending them into a deep sleep. If the
target has the Prone Condition, they gain the Unconscious
Condition as they fall asleep. They remain unconscious for the
duration, although loud noises or being moved or jostled will
awaken them instantly. If your targets are standing or sitting
when affected, they start themselves awake as they hit the
ground, gaining the Prone Condition, but remaining conscious.
If your target is not resisting, and is suitably tired, they will pass
into a deep and restful sleep.
spells.summary: 넘어진 대상은 지속시간 동안 의식을 잃습니다. 서 있거나 앉은 대상은 넘어지면서 깨어나므로 넘어짐만 얻습니다. 소음·접촉·이동으로 잠에서 깰 수 있습니다.
spells.textKo: 넘어진 대상은 지속시간 동안 의식을 잃습니다. 서 있거나 앉은 대상은 넘어지면서 깨어나므로 넘어짐만 얻습니다. 소음·접촉·이동으로 잠에서 깰 수 있습니다.

spells.name: Sly Hands
spells.text:
You teleport a small object — no bigger than your fist — from
about your person into your hand.
spells.summary: 자신이 지닌 주먹보다 작은 물품을 손으로 순간이동시킵니다.
spells.textKo: 자신이 지닌 주먹보다 작은 물품을 손으로 순간이동시킵니다.

spells.name: Sounds
spells.text:
You create small noises nearby. You can create quiet, indistinct
noises that sound as if they come from a specific location within
range,regardless of line of sight.The noises can evoke something
specific, such as footsteps, whispers, or the howl of an animal,
but nothing so distinct that it might convey a message. While
the Spell is active, you may control the sounds by passing an
Average (+2 SL) Willpower Test. A success allows you to move
the sounds to another point within range, or to increase or
decrease their volume.
spells.summary: 시야와 무관하게 가까운 곳에 발소리·속삭임 같은 모호한 소리를 만듭니다. 메시지를 전달할 만큼 뚜렷하지 않습니다. 보통(+2 SL) 의지 판정으로 위치와 크기를 조절합니다.
spells.textKo: 시야와 무관하게 가까운 곳에 발소리·속삭임 같은 모호한 소리를 만듭니다. 메시지를 전달할 만큼 뚜렷하지 않습니다. 보통(+2 SL) 의지 판정으로 위치와 크기를 조절합니다.

spells.name: Spring
spells.text:
You touch the ground and water bubbles forth at the rate of 1
pint per Round, to a total of your Initiative Bonus in pints.
spells.summary: 땅에 손을 대면 라운드마다 물 1파인트가 솟아납니다. 총량은 주도력 보너스 파인트입니다.
spells.textKo: 땅에 손을 대면 라운드마다 물 1파인트가 솟아납니다. 총량은 주도력 보너스 파인트입니다.

spells.name: Twitch
spells.text:
You cause a small object to move, slightly. Something may fall
from a shelf, or a book may slam its pages shut. If the object is
held, the holder must pass an Average (+2 SL) Dexterity Test
or drop the object.
spells.summary: 작은 물품을 조금 움직입니다. 누가 들고 있다면 보통(+2 SL) 손재주 판정에 실패할 때 떨어뜨립니다.
spells.textKo: 작은 물품을 조금 움직입니다. 누가 들고 있다면 보통(+2 SL) 손재주 판정에 실패할 때 떨어뜨립니다.

spells.name: Warning
spells.text:
You channel magic into an object, noticing immediately if it has
been poisoned, infected, or trapped.
Arcane Spells
Treat Arcane Spells as extra options for every Lore of Magic,
including Witch, Dark, and Chaos Lores. They are counted as
Lore Spells in all ways, meaning they get the Lore Attributes of
Lore Spells, and can only be learned from and taught to those
sharing the same Arcane Magic or Chaos Magic Talent.
How these Spells manifest in practice will depend on the Lore
of Magic you use. For instance, a spellcaster using the Lore of
Fire’s Drop may cause the object to overheat,while a practitioner
of the Lore of Shadows may make it slightly insubstantial,
causing the object to literally slip between the target’s fingers.
spells.summary: 물품에 독·감염·함정이 있는지 즉시 알아냅니다.
spells.textKo: 물품에 독·감염·함정이 있는지 즉시 알아냅니다.

spells.name: Aethyric Armour
spells.text:
You gain +1 Armour Point to all Hit Locations as you wrap
yourself in a protective swathe of magic.
spells.summary: 마법의 보호막을 둘러 모든 명중 부위의 방어점에 1을 더합니다.
spells.textKo: 마법의 보호막을 둘러 모든 명중 부위의 방어점에 1을 더합니다.

the weapons in page 301.

spells.name: Arrow Shield
spells.text:
Any missiles containing organic matter, such as arrows with
wooden shafts, are automatically destroyed if they pass within
the Area of Effect, causing no damage to their target. Missiles
comprising only inorganic matter, such as throwing knives and
pistol shots, are unaffected.
spells.summary: 의지 보너스 야드 안을 통과하는 나무 화살 등 유기물을 포함한 투사체를 파괴합니다. 금속 투척칼·총탄처럼 무기물로만 이뤄진 투사체는 막지 못합니다.

spells.name: Breath
spells.text:
Choose a target within 20 + Willpower Bonus yards and make
a Challenging (+0 SL) Ballistic Skill Test. The target, and any
creature within Initiative Bonus yards of them, may oppose your
result with a Dodge Test. Those who fail to beat your result are
struck by this spell.
Breath inflicts Willpower Bonus Damage. The effects of this
spell vary depending on the Lore used to cast it.
0 Acid (Metal): Damage is increased by 4. Weapons and
armour carried by affected targets each suffer 1 Damage.
0 Cold (Beasts, Light, Necromancy): Damage is increased by
2. Targets gain a Fatigued Condition. Until it is removed,
their weapons gain the Slow Flaw.
0 Electricity (Heavens): Damage is increased by 2. Damage
ignores metal armour. Targets gain a Stunned Condition.
0 Fire (Fire, Daemonology, Waaagh!, and Tzeentch Chaos
Lores): Damage is increased by 5. Targets gain an Ablaze
Condition.
0 Poison (Death, Life, Witchcraft, Skaven, and Nurgle or
Slaanesh Chaos Lores): Damage is increased by 2. Targets
gain a Poisoned Condition.
0 Smoke (Shadows): The spell inflicts no Damage. Instead,
the affected area fills with smoke, blocking line of sight
and causing Suffocation (page 169) for Willpower Bonus
Rounds.
spells.summary: 20+의지 보너스 야드 안의 지점을 향해 사격술 판정을 합니다. 그 지점의 주도력 보너스 야드 안 대상은 회피로 대항합니다. 기본 피해는 의지 보너스입니다. 금속은 +4 피해와 장비 손상, 냉기는 +2 피해·피로·느림, 천상은 +2 피해·금속 방어점 무시·기절, 화염은 +5 피해·불붙음, 독은 +2 피해·중독을 적용합니다. 그림자는 피해 대신 시야를 막는 연기와 질식을 일으킵니다.

spells.name: Breath
spells.text:
Choose a target within 20 + Willpower Bonus yards and make
a Challenging (+0 SL) Ballistic Skill Test. The target, and any
creature within Initiative Bonus yards of them, may oppose your
result with a Dodge Test. Those who fail to beat your result are
struck by this spell.
Breath inflicts Willpower Bonus Damage. The effects of this
spell vary depending on the Lore used to cast it.
0 Acid (Metal): Damage is increased by 4. Weapons and
armour carried by affected targets each suffer 1 Damage.
0 Cold (Beasts, Light, Necromancy): Damage is increased by
2. Targets gain a Fatigued Condition. Until it is removed,
their weapons gain the Slow Flaw.
0 Electricity (Heavens): Damage is increased by 2. Damage
ignores metal armour. Targets gain a Stunned Condition.
0 Fire (Fire, Daemonology, Waaagh!, and Tzeentch Chaos
Lores): Damage is increased by 5. Targets gain an Ablaze
Condition.
0 Poison (Death, Life, Witchcraft, Skaven, and Nurgle or
Slaanesh Chaos Lores): Damage is increased by 2. Targets
gain a Poisoned Condition.
0 Smoke (Shadows): The spell inflicts no Damage. Instead,
the affected area fills with smoke, blocking line of sight
and causing Suffocation (page 169) for Willpower Bonus
Rounds.

spells.name: Bridge
spells.text:
You create a bridge of magical energy, with a maximum length
and breadth of your Willpower Bonus in yards. For every +2
SL, you may increase length or breadth by your Willpower
Bonus in yards.

spells.name: Chain Attack
spells.text:
You channel a twisting spur of rupturing magic into your
target. This is a Damage +4 magic missile. If Chain Attack deals
more Wounds than the target’s Toughness Bonus, it leaps to
the nearest other target within Willpower Bonus yards of the
previous target, inflicting –1 Damage each time. It may leap a
maximum number of times equal to your Willpower Bonus. For
every +2 SL achieved, it may chain to an additional target.
spells.summary: 피해 +4의 마법 투사체입니다. 강인함 보너스를 초과하는 운드를 잃게 하면 의지 보너스 야드 안의 다음 대상에게 옮겨 갑니다. 옮겨 갈 때마다 피해가 1 감소하며 최대 의지 보너스번 도약합니다. 추가 2 SL마다 한 번 더 도약할 수 있습니다.
spells.textKo: 피해 +4의 마법 투사체입니다. 강인함 보너스를 초과하는 운드를 잃게 하면 의지 보너스 야드 안의 다음 대상에게 옮겨 갑니다. 옮겨 갈 때마다 피해가 1 감소하며 최대 의지 보너스번 도약합니다. 추가 2 SL마다 한 번 더 도약할 수 있습니다.

spells.name: Corrosive Blood
spells.text:
You infuse yourself with magic, lending your blood a fearsome
potency. You gain the Corrosive Blood Creature Trait (see page
357) for Toughness Bonus Rounds. Alternatively, for Toughness
Bonus hours, all small parasites (fleas, leeches, etc.) that bite
you instantly die and transmit no disease. Blood Rot and similar
diseases are purged from your body.
spells.summary: 강인함 보너스 라운드 동안 부식성 피 특성을 얻습니다. 대신 강인함 보너스 시간 동안 작은 기생충을 죽이고 피썩음 같은 질병을 제거하는 방식으로 사용할 수도 있습니다.
spells.textKo: 강인함 보너스 라운드 동안 부식성 피 특성을 얻습니다. 대신 강인함 보너스 시간 동안 작은 기생충을 죽이고 피썩음 같은 질병을 제거하는 방식으로 사용할 수도 있습니다.

spells.name: Move Object
spells.text:
Using magic, you grab hold of a non-sentient object no larger
than 1 + SL yards in any dimension, moving it with the sheer
force of your will, which is considered to have a Strength equal
to your Willpower. You may move the object up to Willpower
Bonus yards. If anyone attempts to impede the object’s
movement, make an Opposed Willpower/Strength Test. For
every +2 SL, you may increase the distance the object is moved
by Willpower Bonus yards.
spells.summary: 어느 방향의 길이도 1+시전 SL 야드를 넘지 않는 비생물 물체를 의지 보너스 야드 이동시킵니다. 저항하는 상대와 의지 대 근력으로 대항합니다. 추가 2 SL마다 이동 거리를 의지 보너스 야드 늘립니다.

spells.name: Move Object
spells.text:
Using magic, you grab hold of a non-sentient object no larger
than 1 + SL yards in any dimension, moving it with the sheer
force of your will, which is considered to have a Strength equal
to your Willpower. You may move the object up to Willpower
Bonus yards. If anyone attempts to impede the object’s
movement, make an Opposed Willpower/Strength Test. For
every +2 SL, you may increase the distance the object is moved
by Willpower Bonus yards.

spells.name: Mundane Aura
spells.text:
You drain all the Winds of Magic from within your body and
your possessions, removing any magical aura. For the duration
of the Spell, you appear mundane to the Magical Sense Talent
and similar. You effectively have no magical ability and your
magical nature cannot be detected by any means. While this
Spell is in effect, you cannot cast any other Spells. Mundane
Aura immediately ends if you make a Channelling Test.
spells.summary: 자신과 소지품의 마법 기운을 숨깁니다. 지속시간 동안 다른 주문을 시전할 수 없습니다. 마력 집중 판정을 하면 즉시 끝납니다.

distracting your foes. While the Spell is active, gain the
Distracting Creature Trait (see page 358).

spells.name: Dome
spells.text:
You create a dome of magical energy overhead, blocking
incoming attacks. Anyone within the Area of Effect gains
the Ward 6+ Creature Trait (see page 363) against Magical or
ranged attacks originating outside the dome. Those within
may attack out of the dome as normal, and the dome does not
impede movement.
spells.summary: 효과 범위 밖에서 들어오는 마법·원거리 공격에 대해 범위 안의 대상들이 방호 6+를 얻습니다. 안에서 밖으로 하는 공격과 이동은 제한하지 않습니다.

spells.name: Drop
spells.text:
You channel magic into an object being held by the target
creature. This could be a weapon, a rope, or someone’s hand.
Unless a Challenging (+0 SL) Dexterity Test is passed, the
item is dropped. For every +2 SL, you may impose -1 SL on the
Dexterity Test.
spells.summary: 대상이 들고 있는 물품 하나를 놓치게 합니다. 대상은 보통 난이도가 아닌 도전적(+0 SL) 손재주 판정으로 저항합니다. 추가 2 SL마다 저항 판정에 −1 SL을 줄 수 있습니다.
spells.textKo: 대상이 들고 있는 물품 하나를 놓치게 합니다. 대상은 보통 난이도가 아닌 도전적(+0 SL) 손재주 판정으로 저항합니다. 추가 2 SL마다 저항 판정에 −1 SL을 줄 수 있습니다.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.text:
Using magic,you entrap your target,wrapping them in whatever
suits your Lore: vines, shadows, their own clothing… Your
target gains one Entangled Condition with a Strength equal to
your Willpower.
spells.summary: 대상에게 얽힘 1개를 부여합니다. 이를 벗어나기 위해 대항하는 근력은 시전자의 의지와 같습니다.
spells.textKo: 대상에게 얽힘 1개를 부여합니다. 이를 벗어나기 위해 대항하는 근력은 시전자의 의지와 같습니다.

spells.name: Push
spells.text:
All targets around you are pushed back your Willpower Bonus
in yards, take 1d10 Damage ignoring Armour Points, and gain
the Prone Condition. If they collide into a creature the same
Size or smaller, that creature gains the Prone Condition (but
takes no Damage). For every +2 SL, you may push creatures
back another Willpower Bonus in yards.

spells.name: Silence
spells.text:
You create a zone around you through which no noise can
travel. Within the zone, no sound can be heard, and people
outside the zone cannot hear anything emanating from it. This
interferes with the casting of Spells: the Difficulty of Casting
Tests increases by one step.

spells.text:

SL in yards. This movement allows you to traverse gaps, avoid
perils and pitfalls, and ignore obstacles.
